title: Regional Sales Manager, Brazil (Chinese Speaking)
description:
Job Overview

We are looking for a country manager with entrepreneurial spirit and strong results orientation, responsible for building and leading the company's business in the LATAM region from scratch. This is a unique high-impact position suitable for sales leaders who crave challenges and autonomy. You will be responsible for developing market entry strategies, establishing key partnerships, building high-performance sales teams, and driving significant revenue growth. Your success will be directly rewarded through an unlimited commission structure.

Main responsibilities

  • Partnership Development : Proactively identify, approach, and build strong relationships with strategic partners, affiliates, communities, and key opinion leaders (KOLs). Maintain high outreach velocity and continuously expand a quality partner network.
  • Business Growth & KPI Achievement : Drive regional performance by improving key commercial metrics related to customer acquisition, engagement, and overall revenue contribution. Deliver measurable business impact through disciplined execution and performance tracking.
  • Full BD Process Ownership : Independently manage the entire BD lifecycle - prospecting, qualification, negotiation, follow-ups, closing, and post-deal maintenance. Ensure fast execution and a healthy pipeline.
  • Client & Partner Relationship Management : Build and maintain long-term, trust-based relationships with partners. Increase engagement, retention, and contribution through proactive and high-frequency communication.
  • Market Research & Competitive Insights : Monitor regulatory updates, competitor strategies, user behaviour, and market dynamics in the LATAM region. Provide actionable insights and identify new partnership opportunities.
  • Localized Marketing Collaboration : Work closely with marketing teams to support localized content, community engagement, and event initiatives. Ensure smooth and effective execution across Portuguese-speaking markets.Re all sales and partnership activities comply with local regulations and company policies.

Job requirements (must be met)

  • Minimum 2-3 years of experience in sales or business development, capable of independently acquiring and converting clients.
  • Strong execution, self-discipline, and ability to work effectively in a remote, fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to maintain long-term relationships and manage high-frequency partner interactions.
  • Good command of English and Portuguese for business communication (Mandarin proficiency is a strong plus).
  • High resilience and emotional stability under pressure and rejection.
  • Existing partner, affiliate, community, or KOL resources that can contribute value in the short term.
  • Experience in digital platforms, online services, fintech, or other performance-driven industries, or strong personal familiarity with similar ecosystems.
  • Strong hunter mindset: bonus-driven, results-oriented, and motivated by performance-based outcomes.

We provide

  • Uncapped Income Potential: An attractive compensation package that includes a generous base salary and more importantly an uncapped commission structure that directly rewards your performance.
  • Autonomy and Influence: Freedom to form your own team and develop strategies for the entire region. Your decisions will directly affect the global success of the company.
  • Career Development: This is a senior leadership position where you will have great career and financial advancement opportunities as the company grows.
  • Global Environment: Work with a diverse international team to serve customers worldwide.
  • Remote work flexibility: can work from anywhere in the world.

title: Data Tech Lead
description:
A VMBears é uma empresa jovem e moderna com o objetivo de ajudar seus clientes a aproveitar novas tecnologias para acelerar seus negócios. Fornece serviços de consultoria para arquitetura corporativa e modernização de sistemas para nuvem. Fundada em 2018, possui em seu DNA a ética, a positividade, o comprometimento e a inovação. Somos focados em oferecer os melhores serviços prestados através dos melhores profissionais do mercado. Esses recursos são utilizados para auxiliar os clientes em sua jornada de modernização tecnológica e transformação digital.

O Dat a Tech Lea d é um desenvolvedor de software, responsável por liderar uma equipe de desenvolvimento e responsável pela qualidade de seus produtos técnicos. Um Tech Lead eficaz provê toda uma visão técnica à sua equipe de desenvolvimento e trabalha junto aos desenvolvedores para transformá-la em realidade. Ao longo do caminho, um líder técnico assumirá características inerentes a outras funções como liderança de equipe, arquitetura de software, mas permanecerá intrinsecamente ligado ao código-fonte do produto

O que você vai fazer?

  • Liderar e inspirar desenvolvedores, incentivando a curiosidade e o engajamento com o propósito do time.
  • Comunicar lacunas e oportunidades técnicas em linguagem acessível ao negócio.
  • Facilitar discussões sobre trade-offs entre tecnologias e ferramentas.
  • Fomentar uma cultura de root-cause analysis e aprendizado pós-incidente.
  • Conectar a visão arquitetural big picture da companhia com os detalhes da arquitetura da solução.
  • Desenhar a arquitetura de dados distribuída, garantindo latência e throughput que atendam aos requisitos do negócio.
  • Implantar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e publicação que suportem batch e streaming em larga escala.
  • Orientar desenvolvedores na otimização de jobs Spark/Flink e no uso adequado de data warehouses colunares.
  • Definir padrões de versionamento, catalogação e lineage de dados para rastreabilidade de processamento.

Requisitos Imprescindíveis

  • Experiência comprovada como Engenheiro(a) de Dados, com histórico sólido na área, forte pensamento lógico e resolução de problemas complexos.
  • Proficiência em linguagens de programação (Python, Java ou outras) e SQL para manipulação e gerenciamento de dados.
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias de Big Data e processamento de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Experiência com Sistemas de Gerenciamento de Banco de Dados (SGBD) para projetar e manter estruturas eficientes e processos críticos.
  • Habilidade em documentação, aplicação de boas práticas de arquitetura de dados e pensamento analítico.
  • Capacidade de monitorar custos e performance em Redshift, BigQuery ou Athena, propondo ajustes de partição, compressão e caching .
  • Habilidade para implementar testes de qualidade de dados e observabilidade end-to-end nos pipelines críticos.

Stack Desejável

  • Data Warehouses & Data Lakes: Redshift, BigQuery, Snowflake, Athena, Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake.
  • Processamento: Spark (DataFrames, Structured Streaming), Flink, EMR, Dataproc, Databricks, Hadoop (YARN, HDFS).
  • Ingestão & Mensageria: Apache NiFi, Kafka Connect, AWS DMS, Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub.
  • Orquestração & Observabilidade: Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, OpenTelemetry, DataHub, Great Expectations.
  • Infraestrutura & Qualidade: Terraform (IaC), CI/CD (Git), testes de dados automatizados e segurança/LGPD (IAM fine-grained , criptografia em repouso e em trânsito).

Benefícios Oferecidos

  • Modelo 100% Remoto: Auxílio home office e a flexibilidade de trabalhar de onde estiver.
  • Saúde e Bem-estar: Descontos em academias através do TotalPass.
  • Incentivo aos Estudos: Reembolso total de certificações necessárias para sua atuação profissional.
  • Programa de Indicação: Bônus de R$ 2.000,00 por indicação de novos colaboradores ("Bears") que permaneçam conosco por mais de 3 meses.

title: Bookkeeper
description:

Aerial Core is a modern, tech-enabled back-office partner that supports growing businesses through accounting, finance, and people operations services. We’ve intentionally broken the mold of traditional accounting firms by placing relationships, collaboration, and innovation at the center of how we work.

At Aerial Core, we believe accounting should be more than compliance, it should be strategic, insightful, and human-driven. Our people-first culture values trust, independence, and efficiency, empowering every team member to do their best work while helping clients thrive.

We’re now looking for a tech-savvy, detail-oriented Bookkeeper to join our remote team. Please be informed that this is a contractor position and we will require your CNPJ, this is the perfect opportunity for professionals who value autonomy, flexibility and performance based rewards. You’ll work directly with clients, manage their day-to-day financial operations, and leverage technology to deliver accurate, timely, and strategic bookkeeping support.

What You’ll Do
  • Handle full-cycle bookkeeping for assigned clients, including AP/AR, bank reconciliations, and month-end close.
  • Maintain accurate financial data using QuickBooks or other cloud-based accounting tools.
  • Prepare clear, insightful financial reports that help clients make better decisions.
  • Communicate with clients and team members through Slack , Zoom , and Google Workspace .
  • Use Asana and Everhour to track projects, deliverables, and timelines.
  • Proactively identify ways to improve processes, automate tasks, and increase efficiency.
  • Prepare necessary documentation and reports for internal and external audit processes.
  • Ensure compliance with accounting standards and Aerial Core’s quality expectations.
What We’re Looking For
  • Fluent in English
  • Proven experience in bookkeeping or accounting
  • Flexibility around working hours, with the understanding that some tasks may require availability during US business hours (mainly Pacific Time)
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and accuracy
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to manage multiple clients independently
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote-first environment using digital tools.
Nice to Have
  • Experience with Asana and Everhour or any other workflow automation tools
  • Familiarity with CRMs or project management systems such as Asana
  • Prior experience working with startups or small businesses
Why You’ll Love Working With Us

At Aerial Core, we do things differently:

  • Trust and Independence: You are your own boss. We trust your expertise and give you the freedom to manage your time and workload.
  • Efficiency and Innovation: We embrace technology and encourage experimentation. If you find a better way to work, we’ll support it.
  • Collaboration and Growth: We win as a team. Our culture is built on helping each other, learning together, and celebrating shared success.
  • Performance-Driven Rewards: Your efforts directly impact your earnings. You’ll receive a retainer contract of R$3,300 with the option to qualify for more contracts.
  • Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere, anytime as long as deadlines are met and excellence is maintained.
The Aerial Core Way
  • Relationships over Transactions: We build lasting relationships by deeply understanding our clients and delivering real value.
  • Strategic Thinking & Judgment: We go beyond the surface, identifying root causes and providing actionable insights.
  • Open Communication: We value transparency and see mistakes as opportunities for growth.
  • Excellence & Accountability: We aim for 10/10 work — delivered early, reviewed thoroughly, and executed with care.

Ready to do accounting differently?

Join a modern, digital-first team where your independence, innovation, and impact truly matter.

title: Head Of Business & Operations (Brazil Resident)
description:
About the company

We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet.

Why this role

We are entering the Brazilian market as a Banco Central do Brasil-authorised Virtual Asset Service Provider, and you would be our first Business & Operations Officer on the ground. Under BCB Resolution 520/2025, VASPs are required to designate a statutory director responsible for conducting the institution's business and ensuring alignment with its commercial and strategic objectives — this is that seat. In your first year, you will have established the operational foundation of Gate's Brazil entity, built the company's commercial presence in the market, and ensured our business activities run in full alignment with the BCB's regulatory expectations.

What you'll do

  • Hold statutory director responsibility for business conduct and operations at a BCB-authorised VASP, with personal accountability for acting in good faith and in the company's best interest
  • Oversee and conduct the institution's day-to-day business activities, ensuring alignment with Gate's commercial strategy and operational objectives in Brazil
  • Act as the primary operational interface between Gate's Brazil entity and its regional and global leadership, translating strategic direction into local execution
  • Maintain personal fitness and propriety;
    disclose, without prompting, anything that touches your fitness, propriety, or potential conflicts — to the company and to the BCB
  • Drive the VASP authorisation process forward on the business and operations workstream, including declarations and documentation the BCB requests on its own timeline
  • Discharge any additional duties prescribed by applicable Brazilian laws, regulations, or by the company

What you'll bring

Must-have

  • Brazilian permanent residency or citizenship , with the ability to maintain ordinary residency in Brazil for as long as the role requires
  • You hold no competing statutory director or officer seat at another regulated entity in Brazil
  • A predominantly commercial and operational profile — you have led or co-led a business unit, market expansion, or operational function, not just supported one
  • Prior experience at a BCB-regulated financial institution, fintech, or crypto/VASP — familiarity with how regulated entities operate in Brazil is essential
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English, written and spoken
  • Willing to undergo a full BCB fit-and-proper review and disclose what it requires

Nice-to-have

  • Prior experience in the crypto or digital asset industry
  • Direct prior engagement with BCB on regulatory filings, inspections, or authorisation processes
  • Academic background or postgraduate training in business, finance, economics, or law

title: Crypto Operations Specialist
description:
About us

Diversas Vagas is a recruitment agency working with companies in fintech, digital assets and online payments. We handle hiring for partners who need people with real technical experience, not just a matching keyword on a CV. This role is open at one of our partner companies, a digital asset business with a distributed team, and we are running the search and the first stages of the process.

About the role

Our partner is looking for a Crypto Operations Specialist to own their daily crypto operations. You will be the person responsible for making sure funds move correctly, safely and on time.

What you will do

  • Handle incoming and outgoing crypto transfers, conversions between assets, and movement of funds between wallets and exchange accounts.
  • Work with non-custodial wallets (MetaMask, Trust Wallet, Safe, hardware wallets) across several networks, including Ethereum, Tron, BNB Chain, Solana, Polygon and Arbitrum.
  • Manage company accounts on major exchanges: deposits and withdrawals, spot conversions, withdrawal limits, address whitelisting, account verification and support tickets.
  • Choose the right network for each transfer, check fees before sending, and run test transactions before larger amounts go out.
  • Monitor transactions through block explorers, confirm settlements, and investigate transfers that are delayed, stuck or failed.
  • Keep accurate records of every operation, reconcile wallet and exchange balances daily, and prepare regular reports for the finance team.
  • Follow and improve internal security procedures: seed phrase and key handling, hardware wallet use, two-factor authentication, access rights, separation of hot and cold storage.
  • Review operations for anything unusual, follow AML and KYC procedures, and escalate anything that looks wrong before it becomes a problem.
  • Work closely with finance, product and support. You will be the person other teams come to with questions about crypto payments, so clear communication matters here.
  • Help document the process. The company wants procedures written down, not kept in someone's head.

What we are looking for

  • At least 2 years of hands-on experience in crypto. This is not a role for someone who has only traded on the side.
  • Real practical experience with non-custodial wallets. You should be comfortable managing keys, setting up multisig, connecting to different networks and recovering access when something goes wrong.
  • Experience working with centralized exchanges, including withdrawals, deposits, verification and limits.
  • Solid understanding of crypto asset security and common attack methods: phishing, fake sites, address poisoning, malicious contract approvals.
  • Strong attention to detail. A wrong network or one wrong character in an address is money gone, and we need someone who checks twice by habit.
  • Ability to work independently, keep your own records in order and report clearly on what you did.
  • Working level of English for internal communication and exchange support.
  • Stable internet connection and your own computer.

Nice to have

  • Experience with DeFi protocols, bridges and stablecoin flows.
  • Familiarity with blockchain analytics tools such as Chainalysis or similar.
  • Previous work in fintech, payments or an exchange.
  • Confident with spreadsheets and basic reporting.

What the role offers

  • Salary: $240,000 – $270,000 per year
  • Paid vacation
  • Full medical insurance
  • Remote work with flexible hours, as long as key operations are covered
  • Equipment and hardware wallets covered by the company
  • Budget for professional courses and certifications
  • Small team, direct communication, no long approval chains

What You’ll Do

What Success Looks Like

In this role, you will help us:

  • Improve website usability and customer conversion

  • Improve packaging and onboarding experiences
  • Turn customer feedback into actionable product improvements

What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in UX Design, Product Design, Interaction Design, or a related field

  • Strong UX research and usability testing experience
  • Experience creating wireframes, prototypes, and journey maps
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

Tools

  • Figma

Who Will Thrive Here

title: Short-Form Video Editor
description:
Short-Form Video Editor – Social Media & Content

Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time

Schedule: 40 hours/week

About the Client

Our client is a marketing and creative agency that helps brands grow through a combination of digital marketing, social media, content creation, video production, paid media, and creative design .

The agency works with brands across different industries, developing engaging, social-first content designed to build audiences, increase brand visibility, and support business growth.

The team is currently expanding its video production capabilities to support a new college-focused social app . The project will involve creating authentic, engaging short-form content featuring college campuses, student conversations, street interviews, and promotional material.

About the Role

We are looking for a Short-Form Video Editor to join the creative team and support the launch of a new social app designed for college students.

The primary focus of this role will be editing short-form social media content for platforms such as Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.

You will work with raw footage, often recorded on phones or other lightweight equipment, and turn it into polished, engaging content that feels natural to a young U.S. audience.

A strong understanding of social media culture, Gen Z content, pacing, storytelling, and current short-form video trends is important for this role.

Candidates with previous experience editing street interviews, man-on-the-street content, campus videos, interviews, UGC, or youth-oriented social content are especially encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities

  • Edit short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and other social platforms.
  • Turn raw phone-shot and camera footage into polished, engaging social content.
  • Edit college campus tours, street interviews, student conversations, promotional videos, and UGC-style content.
  • Review large amounts of raw footage and identify the strongest moments, reactions, quotes, and answers.
  • Create strong hooks that capture attention within the first few seconds.
  • Build a clear and engaging story from multiple clips.
  • Use jump cuts, hard cuts, B-roll, and pacing to maintain viewer attention.
  • Cut footage to music and beats when appropriate.
  • Add captions, subtitles, text overlays, and other social-first elements.
  • Perform basic color correction and audio cleanup.
  • Maintain consistency in visual quality, pacing, and editing style across content.
  • Repurpose footage into multiple short-form pieces when appropriate.
  • Incorporate feedback and revisions efficiently.
  • Manage a high volume of content during the app's launch period.
  • Potentially support video projects for other agency clients as the role develops.

Requirements

  • Proven experience editing short-form social media content .
  • Strong proficiency with Adobe Premiere Pro or comparable Adobe video-editing software.
  • Strong understanding of pacing, storytelling, and visual rhythm.
  • Ability to turn raw footage into engaging short-form content.
  • Experience with basic color correction and audio editing.
  • Ability to work effectively with phone-shot, raw, and imperfect footage.
  • Good understanding of TikTok, Instagram Reels, and other short-form formats.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines.
  • Ability to work independently while taking direction and incorporating feedback.
  • Strong English communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience editing street interviews or man-on-the-street videos .
  • Experience with college, campus, student, Gen Z, lifestyle, dating, social, or UGC content.
  • Experience editing interviews and multi-person conversations.
  • Experience working with high-volume social media content.
  • Familiarity with Adobe After Effects .
  • Basic motion graphics and animation skills.
  • Experience creating engaging captions and animated text.
  • Strong awareness of current TikTok and Instagram editing trends.

The ideal candidate knows how to:

  • Start with a strong hook.
  • Remove unnecessary pauses, filler, and dead space.
  • Keep conversations moving with natural cuts and jump cuts.
  • Identify the funniest, most interesting, surprising, or relatable moments.
  • Combine multiple interview responses into a cohesive story.
  • Use B-roll strategically.
  • Add clean, readable captions.
  • Use music and sound effects when they enhance the content.
  • Keep the content authentic and conversational.
  • Avoid excessive transitions, effects, and animations when they don't add value.

title: Technical Lead
description:

title: Retail Credit Risk Manager
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

Risk at Revolut operates across all functions, products, and regions to monitor front-line performance and ensure the business operates safely. They’re among the first to be involved in new initiatives, from tech to customer support.

We’re looking for a Risk Manager who'll support growing our retail credit portfolio. You'll make data-driven decisions on risk-adjusted return requirements and lead preventive and reactive actions that impact portfolio credit performance and profitability.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

What you'll be doing

  • Overseeing exposure to retail credit risk
  • Working with the Risk Modelling team to design, develop, and implement retail credit risk models
  • Managing risk appetite through limit calibration and monitoring
  • Maintaining key policies, procedures, and controls
  • Engaging with first-line businesses to identify, monitor, and govern emerging retail credit risks, including new product risk assessments
  • Engaging with key stakeholders, committees, and regional regulators on material retail credit risk exposures and limit governance

The Case Assembly Drafter plays a pivotal role in preparing, organizing, and finalizing all components of a client’s immigration case prior to attorney review. This position ensures every filing is complete, accurate, and supported by required evidence. Ideal candidates bring exceptional attention to detail, strong writing skills, and the ability to manage multiple case components in a fast‑paced, mission‑driven environment.

  • Submit finalized case packets for attorney review using Airtable workflows.

  • Verify completeness and consistency of all required evidence.

Quality Control & Accuracy Checks

  • Conduct credibility checks to ensure dates, timelines, and narratives align across all documents.
  • Confirm all mandatory documents are present before submitting cases for review.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Submit formal requests to hold cases in abeyance when appropriate.
  • Coordinate with internal departments to obtain missing documents or follow‑up information.

Required Competencies & Skills

  • Bilingual or professional fluency in English.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to identify inconsistencies in client narratives and timelines.
  • Strong writing skills for drafting affidavits, cover letters, and formal requests.
  • Solid understanding of immigration case components and evidence requirements.
  • Excellent organizational and time‑management abilities.
  • Skilled in tracking signatures, evaluations, and supporting documentation.
  • Strong communication skills for client coordination and internal collaboration.
  • Comfort using Airtable, PDF tools, and online filing systems.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive pay above market rate.
  • Comprehensive training.
  • Paid vacation + sick leave.
  • Your birthday off.
  • U.S. paid holidays.
  • Mon–Fri, 9 AM–6 PM PST.
  • A mission‑driven, inclusive, supportive team.

title: Qc Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil
description:
About Us

Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.

At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.

Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.

Role Overview

As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.

Key Responsibilities

1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files)

  • Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script.
  • Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards.
  • Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.

2. Script-to-Audio Alignment

  • Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression.
  • Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.

3. Technical & Creative Accuracy

  • Check audio for:
  • Voice clarity and consistency
  • Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness
  • Background noise or distortions
  • Timing and pacing issues
  • Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files
  • Grammatically incorrect words/sentences
  • Physical noise of voice artist
  • Abrupt cut / jerk
  • Sibilance
  • Fumble / mumble

4. Vendor & Artist Coordination

  • Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.
  • Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.

5. QC Documentation & Tracking

  • Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level.
  • Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content).
  • Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.

6. Pre-Release Quality Checks

  • Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform.
  • Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.

7. Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality.
  • Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.

8. Process Improvement

  • Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies.
  • Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows.
  • Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience
  • Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology

9. Volume & Deadline Management

  • Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines.
  • Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.

10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement

Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to:

  • Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns
  • Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress
  • Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation
  • Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses
  • Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes
  • Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery

Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.

Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.

Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics.
  • Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred.
  • Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus.
  • Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content.
  • Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment.
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills.
  • Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment.
  • Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.

Language requirements

  • Fluent Portugese
  • Professional working proficiency in English

This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.

Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

description:

A Doppa conecta pessoas que querem se tornar criadoras de conteúdo a marcas licenciadas do setor de apostas esportivas e cassino online (iGaming), um dos segmentos mais aquecidos do mercado digital brasileiro hoje.

title: Senior Ai Agent Engineer
description:
About FirstIgnite

FirstIgnite makes software for university tech transfer offices. Those are the people who take research

coming out of a university lab and get it patented, licensed, or spun out into a company.

The role

We're hiring a Senior AI Agent Engineer. You'll build the agents in our product, and you'll build the

evals that tell us whether each change made them better or worse.

The work is document-heavy rather than chat. The agents run multi-step, call tools, read long and

inconsistently formatted source material, check it against existing records, and produce output that a

person reviews before anything happens with it.

Accuracy matters more here than speed or novelty. Most of the engineering effort goes into precision,

traceability, and getting the agent to hand off to a human at the right moment.

You'll report to the Head of Engineering and work with product and the full-stack team. If you've

shipped agents before, you've probably had the experience of changing a prompt and having no idea

whether you improved anything. That problem is most of this job.

What you'll do

- Design and ship long-running, multi-step, tool-using agents on various AI SDKs and tooling,

included but not limited to the OpenAI Agents SDK, the Anthropic Agent SDK, the Vercel AI SDK,

LangGraph, MCP, and Temporal Cloud.

- Wrap our APIs and our partners' APIs as tools an agent can call over MCP. Some of those systems

are old, single-tenant, and outside our control, so a fair amount of the work is translation.

- Get structured data out of long documents and match it against records that already exist. Expect

entity resolution and fuzzy matching, and expect much of it to run in batch.

- Stand up eval suites using various evaluation frameworks and tooling, included but not limited to

Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, DeepEval, LLM-as-judge methods, and custom harnesses.

Measure tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and whether the agent finished the task.

- Every agent here produces a draft that a person signs off on. Build the citations and confidence

signals that make that review fast, and give the agent a clear way to escalate.

- Sit with product and domain experts and turn vague quality goals into something measurable.

Sometimes the only dataset available for that is tiny, or confidential, or both.

- Instrument production traffic, turn real customer interactions into golden datasets, and run them as

regression tests.

- Compare models against each other (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), along with prompt

strategies and agent designs, and know what each option costs in latency and quality.

- Bootstrap quality signal for features that have no production traffic yet. That usually means

generating synthetic documents and test cases, including the ugly edge cases real customers will

eventually send us, and knowing where synthetic data stops being a good proxy.

- Write the templates, docs, and tooling the rest of the team needs to run evals without coming to

you.

Required Qualifications:

- 3+ years of engineering experience, including hands-on work on LLM or agent systems that real

users touched.

- You've evaluated agents, not only models, and you know why single-turn accuracy says little about

a multi-step run.

- You've integrated against APIs you don't own, including old ones with bad documentation, and

turned them into something an agent can call reliably.

- You're comfortable with document pipelines: pulling data out, normalizing it, and checking it against

a structured source of truth.

- You've used at least one LLM evaluation framework, in-house tooling included.

- You know how LLM-as-judge methods break down (position bias, verbosity bias, judge drift) and

what to do about it.

- You can tell a real regression from noise, and design an experiment that answers the question

being asked instead of a nearby one.

- You can read a customer call transcript, work out which failures matter, and ship a fix and an eval

for them.

- You write clearly. Engineers won't act on eval results they don't read or don't trust.

- You're based somewhere between New York time (ET) and Western European time. Italy is the

furthest east we can go.

You might currently be titled

AI Agent Engineer · Agentic AI Engineer · Senior AI Engineer · AI Systems Engineer · Lead AI

Developer · AI Solutions Architect · AI Integration Specialist · Senior Data Scientist, AI

Titles are all over the place in this space. If the work above matches what you already do, apply. We'll

go on what you've shipped.

Preferred Qualifications:

- You've evaluated retrieval systems: RAG, hybrid search, reranking.

- You've worked with agent orchestration frameworks like Temporal, LangGraph, or the OpenAI

Agents SDK, and you know how long-running tool use goes wrong.

- You have a background in information retrieval or search relevance.

- You've worked somewhere an agent's output carried financial or compliance consequences.

- You've built internal tooling that non-engineers used on their own to label and review model output.

This is a fully remote, full-time permanent position available to candidates located within the New York (ET) through Western Europe time zones, with flexible working hours to support collaboration across regions.

title: Immigration Paralegal (Immigration Court / Removal Defense)
description:
Are you ready to build a meaningful career defending immigrants facing deportation? Do you thrive in fast‑paced environments, stay calm under pressure, and want to fight for people who need it most?

If so, Bueno Law wants to meet you.

About Bueno Law

Bueno Law is a Queer‑owned immigration law firm dedicated to protecting LGBTQ+ immigrants, survivors of domestic violence and human trafficking, and other marginalized communities.

We specialize in:

  • Removal Defense (EOIR).
  • Asylum & Humanitarian Relief (U/T visas, VAWA, SIJS).
  • Family‑Based Immigration.

We’re expanding our Removal Defense Team and seeking passionate, detail‑driven Paralegals committed to making a real impact.

What You’ll Do (Removal Defense Focus)

  • Support EOIR litigation by preparing filings, motions, briefs, and applications for relief (asylum, cancellation, waivers, adjustment, etc.).
  • Draft client declarations and gather evidence for high‑stakes court submissions.
  • Manage a removal‑defense caseload, track deadlines, and maintain accurate case records.
  • Prepare hearing packets, organize exhibits, and assist attorneys with trial preparation.
  • Communicate with clients—often in emotionally sensitive situations—to collect facts and provide updates.
  • Coordinate with interpreters, experts, and agencies to support case strategy.
  • Prepare and file USCIS petitions for clients with mixed EOIR/USCIS matters.

What We’re Looking For

Hard Skills

  • Fluent in English + Spanish or Portuguese.
  • 3 years experience in with end to end removal defense (need experience with litigation).
  • Strong legal writing, research, and evidence‑gathering skills.
  • Highly organized and detail‑oriented with the ability to manage a heavy caseload.
  • Tech‑savvy and fully equipped for remote work (computer, internet, private workspace, noise‑canceling headphones).

Soft Skills

  • Emotionally intelligent communicator who can support clients during stressful moments.
  • Thrives in fast‑paced, mission‑driven environments.
  • Team‑oriented, proactive, adaptable, and solutions‑focused.
  • A sense of humor—because the work is intense, and we believe in supporting each other.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3 + years of immigration paralegal experience.
  • Experience with both EOIR and USCIS filings.

What We Offer

  • Competitive pay above market rate.
  • Paid vacation + sick leave.
  • Your birthday off.
  • U.S. paid holidays.
  • Mon–Fri, 9 AM–6 PM PST.
  • A mission‑driven, inclusive, supportive team.

Interpretar relatórios de saúde da plataforma e aconselhar sobre planos de remediação relacionados à manutenibilidade, desempenho, segurança e capacidade de atualização.

title: Head Of Risk, Brazil
description:
Role Objective: We are seeking an experienced and highly strategic Statutory Risk Officer to

lead our Risk Management function in Brazil. This executive role is pivotal in acting as the

primary interface with local regulatory bodies, specifically the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN).

The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Operational and Technology Risk, ensuring

our fast-paced operations remain resilient, secure, and fully compliant.

About the Role

As the Statutory Risk Officer, you will hold statutory responsibility for the company's risk

management framework in Brazil. You will act as the designated point of contact for BACEN and

other relevant regulatory bodies, advocating for the business while ensuring strict adherence to local regulatory expectations. While the role requires holistic oversight of the enterprise risk landscape, the primary mandate is to architect, implement, and govern a robust Operational Risk and Technology Risk framework. You will partner with business and technology leaders to identify vulnerabilities, mitigate technological threats, and foster a culture of proactive risk management.

Key Responsibilities

Regulatory Leadership & Statutory Duties

  • Act as the formally appointed Statutory Risk Director before the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN),fulfilling all duties required by BACEN Resolution and related regulations.
  • Serve as the primary liaison for all regulatory inquiries, audits, and supervisory exams related to risk management.
  • Ensure accurate and timely submission of all mandated risk reports to regulators.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and proactively adapt the risk framework to meet emerging legislative and supervisory requirements.

Operational cum Technology Risk Management

  • Oversee the end-to-end Operational Risk Management (ORM) framework, including Risk Control Self-Assessments (RCSA), Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), and Incident Management.
  • Establish and monitor operational risk appetite metrics and thresholds, escalating breaches to the management
  • Drive business continuity planning (BCP) and disaster recovery (DR) strategies to ensure operational resilience.
  • Provide in-depth oversight of Technology Risk, Information Security, and Cyber Security
  • frameworks.
  • Evaluate risks associated with digital transformations, cloud migrations, API integrations, and new technology deployments.
  • Oversee Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), focusing heavily on critical IT vendors and outsourced technology service providers.
  • Review and challenge incident response protocols and post-mortem analysis for IT disruptions or cyber incidents.

Financial Risk (Advantageous Focus)

Good knowledge over end-to-end financial, fraud risk management during payment and money conversion and transfer process, for dual B2C (high-volume, rapid retail transactions) and B2B (high-value invoice/account-to-account payouts) flows.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Law, Economics, Business Administration, Finance, or related field.
  • Strong experience in risk management and/or internal controls within regulated financial institutions in Brazil (banks, payment institutions, brokerages, or asset managers).
  • Solid working knowledge of BCB regulatory processes, norms, and resolutions.
  • Prior experience engaging directly with BCB and/or CVM in a regulatory/supervisory context.
  • Strong understanding of prudential risk frameworks (capital, RWA, operational risk).
  • Brazilian national or foreign national with valid Brazilian residency (statutory officer requirement).
  • Availability and willingness to be formally listed as a company officer with associated legal responsibilities.
  • Fluent Portuguese and Advanced English.
  • Prior experience in virtual assets, crypto, or fintech risk management.
  • Domain Expertise: SME-level knowledge in Operational Risk and Technology/Cyber Risk methodologies.
  • Professional certifications in risk management (e.G., FRM, CRM) a plus.
  • Familiarity with VASP-specific prudential frameworks and evolving BCB guidance on RWA treatment for digital asset activities.

P/S: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted due to overwhelming applicants.

Vision & Mission

OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.

OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

A Kavak iniciou a revolução no mercado automotivo em 2016, criando uma plataforma baseada no uso de dados e tecnologia que compra, recondiciona e vende carros usados pela internet ou nas dependências da empresa (hubs), com todas as garantias de segurança e confiabilidade, além das melhores opções de financiamento. title: Arquitetura De Soluções Azure - 134713
description:

Responsabilidades:

  • Implementar o ZeroLayer Router (autenticação, TLS e lookup do shard map) e o ZeroLayer Router Kafka (isolamento de tópicos por tenant), definindo estratégia de autenticação sem lock-in (OIDC, mTLS).
  • Definir engines relacionais e não relacionais por célula, projetando sharding alinhado ao tenant key, com réplicas, failover e criptografia em repouso e trânsito de forma agnóstica ao provider.
  • Estabelecer padrões de IaC (Terraform) com módulos reutilizáveis por célula e desenhar pipeline CI/CD completo (lint, plan, gates de aprovação, apply e drift detection), suportando o ciclo completo da célula (criação, atualização, re-shard e destruição rastreável).
  • Provisionar AKS por célula com isolamento de rede e Network Policies, projetar topologia de VNet (subnets, peering, conectividade cross-cloud) e gerenciar ciclo de vida de certificados TLS de forma automatizada.
  • Implementar autenticação com provider agnóstico (OIDC/OAuth 2.0), configurar identidades gerenciadas sem segredos estáticos e estabelecer RBAC por célula com princípio de menor privilégio.
  • Implementar estratégia de observabilidade por célula (métricas, logs e traces distribuídos), operando Datadog como plataforma principal (APM, Log Management, dashboards e alertas baseados em SLO), garantindo rastreabilidade ponta a ponta com correlation IDs.

Desejável:

title: Director Of Strategic Partnerships
description:
ABOUT ELIFE

Elife is the unified API infrastructure behind global mobility and instant delivery across 182 countries. We power Super Apps, FinTechs, neobanks, and ride-hailing ecosystems worldwide — we don't compete with them, we enable them. Our partners integrate once and serve their users globally. We build and operate the infrastructure. Our partners own the brand and the customer relationship. We do not compete for our partners' users.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a proven ecosystem hunter — not an account manager, not a loyalty program builder, not a co-marketing specialist. Someone who has personally closed bidirectional commercial deals where both parties share live transaction revenue, through API integrations with super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, or mobility companies.

This is a greenfield, individual contributor role. You will build elife's LATAM pipeline from zero, own the full deal lifecycle from outreach to signed contract, and be expected to deliver active pipeline within the first 90 days.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Identify, engage and close strategic partnerships with super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, ride-hailing operators and e-commerce ecosystems across LATAM
  • Own the full commercial lifecycle — outreach, negotiation, deal structuring, contract execution and partner onboarding
  • Structure and close revenue-share and API integration agreements where elife's infrastructure powers mobility and delivery services inside a partner's platform
  • Build and maintain 20+ active enterprise prospects at any given time
  • Engage C-suite and VP-level decision makers directly — no intermediaries
  • Represent elife at industry events and forums across LATAM
  • Report pipeline, forecasts and market intelligence directly to the VP of Partnerships

WHAT WE NEED — NON-NEGOTIABLE

  • 8+ years of B2B enterprise partnerships experience
  • Minimum 3 years of direct experience closing ecosystem deals with or inside super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, or ride-hailing companies in LATAM
  • Proven track record closing bidirectional revenue-share deals — where revenue is generated by live transactions, not loyalty points, discount campaigns or co-marketing budgets
  • Direct experience structuring and closing API integration partnerships commercially — owning the business case, commercial terms and deal execution end-to-end
  • Active C-suite network verifiable with specific names in at least two of the following: Rappi, Uber, DiDi, MercadoPago, Nu, Clip, Stori, Kavak, iFood or equivalent LATAM super apps or neobanks
  • Multi-country LATAM experience — Mexico and/or Brazil required;
    Colombia, Argentina, Chile a plus
  • Hunter DNA — you have built pipelines from zero, not inherited them
  • Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese required;
    English proficiency required
  • Bachelor's degree minimum;
    MBA strongly preferred

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Prior experience working with or for mobility platforms, ride-hailing operators, corporate travel or fleet technology companies
  • Track record closing first-of-kind or complex ecosystem partnerships with measurable commercial outcomes
  • Experience managing partnerships across multiple LATAM countries simultaneously
  • Familiarity with the regulatory and payments landscape across Brazil, Mexico and Colombia

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Fixed monthly base + KPI bonus scalable up to 300% based on commercial results
  • Uncapped commissions tied directly to the revenue you generate
  • Remote-first with regional travel as required
  • Direct access to C-suite and founder leadership from day one
  • A genuinely entrepreneurial environment where your deals shape elife's growth trajectory in LATAM

MARKET CONTEXT

Latin America is one of the fastest-growing digital financial services markets in the world, led by Brazil and Mexico. The region is home to a dynamic ecosystem of super apps, neobanks, and ride-hailing operators actively seeking scalable mobility and delivery partnerships. The Director of Strategic Partnerships for LATAM will build elife's presence from the ground up in this high-potential, relationship-driven market — and earn accordingly.

title: Licensing Operations, & Financial Resolution Specialist
description:
Location: Brazil (100% Remote or Hybrid for Serra Gaúcha or São Paulo residents)

Compensation Currency: Brazilian Real (BRL)

Contract: Permanent Full Time (CLT) - 42h/week

About Us

Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,400+ employees and 70,000+ customers across 100+ countries. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end-to-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen & Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass & Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North & South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.

Cyncly brings over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end-to-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.

Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specialized in technology.

Role Purpose

This role ensures that customers receive the products, services, licences, and entitlements they have purchased — accurately and with minimal customer effort. The specialist resolves customer enquiries raised via Zendesk that relate to invoices, contracts in Salesforce, and related systems, acting as the operational owner for entitlement, billing, and data integrity matters within standard service levels.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce and NetSuite (the team's go-forward systems);
    willingness and abilityto learn additional legacy systems as needed
  • Prior experience with a ticketing tool such as Zendesk is a plus but not required
  • High level of English, written and spoken — the role requires clear communication with global, internal stakeholders
  • Strong written communication skills and attention to detail
  • Comfortable working across multiple, sometimes unfamiliar, IT systems
  • Able to work under pressure and manage competing priorities
  • Strong team player who collaborates across Sales, Finance, Operations, and Support

Core Responsibilities Entitlement & Licensing Management

  • Accurately assign licences and service entitlements and rapidly activate new purchases
  • Manage upgrades, downgrades, renewals, and licensee transfers/reassignments
  • Monitor licence allocation and usage;
    identify under- or over-utilised licences
  • Verify customers have access to all products and services purchased;
    audit and reconcile entitlements
  • Resolve entitlement discrepancies and prevent access interruptions
  • Interpret contractual entitlement rights and validate product, support, and service eligibility
  • Ensure alignment between contracts, orders, invoices, and entitlement systems, including for complex enterprise agreements

Billing & Invoice Support

  • Own customer billing enquiries end-to-end via Zendesk tickets, from first response through resolution
  • Investigate disputed charges and resolve invoice discrepancies, explaining charges, credits, and taxes clearly
  • Raise credit note requests and provide first-level approval of credit notes raised by other areas
  • Validate contract pricing and entitlements against billing records
  • Handle invoice, statement, and contract copy requests

Data Quality & Master Data Management

  • Maintain the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of customer, billing, and entitlement records
  • Identify and resolve data discrepancies and remove duplicate records
  • Validate data against source systems (Salesforce, NetSuite, and other platforms) and contractual agreements
  • Coordinate master data updates across CRM, billing, licensing, and support platforms
  • Process changes in billing frequency, currency, and historical contract corrections

Reconciliation, Change & Escalation Management

  • Reconcile data between systems and investigate root causes of mismatches
  • Support customer mergers, acquisitions, and organisational/account hierarchy changes
  • Coordinate with Sales, Operations, Finance, and Technical Support on business-critical issues
  • Own priority investigation and escalation of entitlement and data issues within defined SLAs

Reporting

  • Contribute to entitlement summaries, licence position, and renewal/expiry reporting (with the BI team)
  • Support data quality scorecards, customer data health assessments, and root-cause reporting

Service Expectations

  • Proactive: Monitor upcoming expirations and data anomalies;
    flag gaps before they affect the customer
  • Accurate: Get entitlement and data changes right first time, with full traceability
  • Responsive: Provide timely, reliable resolution within standard SLAs
  • Transparent: Give clear visibility into issue status, ownership, and resolution

title: Professor De Francês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!

Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!

A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*

O que oferecemos?

  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .

Necessário:

  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

O diferencial?

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.

Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

O que eu faço?

  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.

Seja diferente, seja independente

Na Origem não existem problemas "dos outros", trabalhamos unidos como um só time e somos eficientes em tudo que fazemos, evitando desperdícios. Entendemos que só assim continuaremos crescendo, gerando oportunidades para todos e contribuindo para uma transição segura da matriz energética brasileira rumo a uma economia de baixo carbono.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Gerente Executivo de Ativo para assumir a gestão integrada do nosso Polo Alagoas, ativo relevante para nossa estratégia de nos consolidarmos como um dos maiores hubs energéticos do Brasil. Neste papel, você será o "dono do ativo", responsável por orquestrar uma operação onshore — que engloba a produção de óleo e gás natural, processamento e estocagem de gás — com foco total em excelência operacional, cultura de segurança e articulação estratégica com stakeholders em um cenário de rápido crescimento. A posição é para atuação em Alagoas, em regime 100% presencial.

Principais responsabilidades e atribuições:

1. Gestão do Ativo

  • Responder pelo resultado do ativo: produção, lifting cost, OPEX e curva de declínio.
  • Responder pela geração dos KPIs operacionais do ativo, pelo controle desses indicadores e pela elaboração dos planos de ação para correção dos desvios.
  • Prover suporte às áreas responsáveis pelo CAPEX, apoiando a priorização, o planejamento e a viabilização dos investimentos direcionados ao ativo.
  • Definir e executar a estratégia de produção e otimização de poços, em interface com o time de reservatórios e produtividade (vinculados a diretoria técnica) para alinhamento das metas de produção.
  • Garantir a confiabilidade e disponibilidade das instalações de produção (poços, linhas, dutos, estações de produção e coletoras e UPGN).

2. Operação de Produção, Processamento e Estocagem

  • Assegurar a operação segura e eficiente das instalações de produção, incluindo separação, tratamento de óleo/gás/água, compressão e processamento de gás natural, injeção e escoamento.
  • Assegurar a operação de estocagem de gás natural, garantindo a segurança, a integridade e a gestão dos volumes armazenados.
  • Gerir a integridade de ativos, garantindo inspeção, manutenção preventiva/preditiva e paradas programadas priorizando equipamentos críticos de segurança operacional.
  • Gerir o processo de planejamento e controle da manutenção, assegurando programação, priorização, execução e controle das ordens de serviço e dos indicadores de manutenção.
  • Gerir o controle de estoque de equipamentos, materiais e sobressalentes, garantindo disponibilidade de itens críticos para a operação e manutenção, evitando paradas por falta de material e otimizando o capital imobilizado em estoque.
  • Gerir a força de trabalho do ativo, garantindo dimensionamento, produtividade, desenvolvimento e engajamento das equipes.
  • Prover suporte e articulação às áreas de Relacionamento Local, SMS, Integridade, Construção & Intervenção de Poços e Construção & Montagem — vinculadas a outras diretorias (respectivamente Jurídico, QSMS & Integridade, Construção e Intervenção de Poços e Projetos), mas que atuam para o ativo — assegurando alinhamento de prioridades e integração das atividades no campo.
  • Prover suporte e articulação às áreas de suporte da Origem (Comercial, Jurídico, Administrativo-Financeiro).
  • Gerir a logística do ativo: armazéns, equipamentos de içamento e movimentação de cargas, transporte de pessoas e abastecimento de diesel.
  • Gerir o suporte operacional: alojamentos, alimentação, segurança patrimonial, manutenção predial, limpeza e conservação e limpeza industrial.
  • Gerir o laboratório de análise da qualidade dos produtos (óleo, gás, GLP) e da água, assegurando a especificação dos produtos e o atendimento aos requisitos técnicos e ambientais.

3. SMS e Conformidade

  • Liderar a cultura de segurança de processo e ocupacional, com foco em zero acidente e prevenção de grandes acidentes.
  • Garantir conformidade regulatória com ANP, IBAMA, órgãos ambientais estaduais e demais autoridades, incluindo o cumprimento das condicionantes do licenciamento ambiental e os planos de resposta a emergências.

4. Representação Institucional

  • Atuar como representante oficial da empresa perante governo estadual, órgãos reguladores, prefeituras, comunidades, superficiários, entidades do setor e mídia no estado.
  • Representar a companhia em fóruns, associações setoriais e negociações de interesse estratégico.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Formação em Engenharia (Petróleo, Mecânica, Química, Produção) ou áreas correlatas e pós-graduação/MBA em áreas de Gestão.
  • Experiência sólida em operação de instalações de produção e em gestão de ativos de E&P onshore ou offshore.
  • Domínio técnico nos processos de produção de petróleo e gás natural;
  • Conhecimento regulatório do setor de petróleo e gás natural;
  • Experiência com a liderança de equipes multidisciplinares em ambiente operacional;
  • Experiência com gestão de custos operacionais e produtividade de ativos maduros.
  • Desejável vivência em elevação artificial, processamento primário, sistemas de escoamento, compressão e processamento de gás natural.
  • Desejável experiência com gestão de integridade e confiabilidade de instalações de produção e processamento.
  • Desejável o conhecimento em segurança de processo, análise de riscos e gestão de barreiras.

O perfil que buscamos:

  • Visão de negócios e orientação a resultados;
  • Disciplina operacional com foco em produtividade e otimização;
  • Comunicação executiva e relacionamento com stakeholders externos;
  • Excelente articulação e representação institucional;
  • Capacidade de negociação e construção de parcerias locais;
  • Tomada de decisão sob pressão e resposta a emergências;
  • Referência em cultura de segurança;

VEM SER ORIGEM!

Estamos entre as principais companhias independentes com atuação no Onshore do Brasil. Nosso maior diferencial é produzir energia por meio do gás natural, recurso energético mais estável e limpo. Com isso, participamos ativamente da expansão e da transformação da matriz de energia brasileira rumo à economia de baixo carbono.

Somos movidos pelo propósito de contribuir para o desenvolvimento do país mediante a integração energética de maneira segura, inovadora e eficiente. Priorizamos a execução de estratégias e projetos responsáveis para promover um desenvolvimento mais homogêneo das regiões onde atuamos.

Nossa origem é feminina, com diferentes nacionalidades e culturas. Temos o compromisso com a diversidade e a pluralidade. Nos orgulhamos da nossa trajetória cheia de energia com audácia, empreendedorismo, inovação e busca por oportunidades. Juntos, vamos apoiar na transição segura da matriz energética brasileira.

title: Pesquisador de Desenvolvimento Analítico Pleno
description:
Sobre a SCIENTIA

Nascemos com o DNA da inovação e hoje somos mais do que simplesmente um laboratório ou uma consultoria, a SCIENTIA é um hub de conhecimento técnico científico de alta qualidade. Nosso propósito é conectar ciência e mercado, e agora estamos abrindo as portas para quem compartilha dessa mesma paixão. Se você busca crescimento técnico em um ambiente colaborativo, venha fazer ciência com a gente!

O Desafio

Estamos em busca de um(a) Pesquisador(a) Pleno com autonomia técnica e visão analítica apurada. Você será responsável pela condução de projetos de desenvolvimento e validação, atuando na resolução de problemas complexos (troubleshooting) e garantindo a robustez técnica das entregas, além de ser uma referência para os analistas júnior.

O que você vai fazer no dia a dia

  • Desenvolvimento Robusto: Desenvolver e otimizar métodos indicativos de estabilidade e análise de produtos de degradação com autonomia, utilizando HPLC e UHPLC.
  • Gestão Técnica: Planejar e executar estudos de degradação forçada (RDC 964/2025 e Guia 04/2015), interpretando dados complexos e perfis de degradação.
  • Validação Completa: Conduzir validações de metodologias analíticas (RDC 166/2017 e Guia 10/2017), garantindo o cumprimento estatístico e regulatório.
  • Documentação e Revisão: Elaborar protocolos e relatórios técnicos complexos, além de auxiliar na revisão de dados brutos gerados pela equipe.
  • Resolução de Problemas: Atuar ativamente no troubleshooting de equipamentos e métodos, propondo soluções técnicas eficientes.
  • Interface Técnica: Participar de discussões científicas avançadas com a equipe e, eventualmente, apoiar no suporte técnico a clientes.

Para se candidatar, você precisa

  • Formação: Superior completo em Química ou Farmácia. Pós-graduação ou especialização na área analítica será um diferencial.
  • Experiência: Experiência sólida e comprovada em laboratório de desenvolvimento analítico (indispensável domínio das rotinas de P&D).
  • Domínio Técnico: Expertise em cromatografia líquida (HPLC/UHPLC) e gasosa (GC), desenvolvimento de métodos do zero e tratamento estatístico de dados.
  • Regulatório: Profundo conhecimento das normas da ANVISA (RDC 964, RDC 166, RDC 318, etc.).
  • Idiomas e Ferramentas: Inglês técnico (leitura avançada/escrita intermediária) e domínio do Pacote Office.
  • Mobilidade: Disponibilidade para viagens eventuais na região da Grande São Paulo.

Por que escolher a SCIENTIA?

Oferecemos um ambiente onde sua experiência é valorizada. Aqui você terá espaço para propor inovações, liderar frentes técnicas e continuar seu desenvolvimento através de um plano de carreira estruturado, com desafios à altura da sua experiência.

Benefícios que cuidam de você

  • Plano de Saúde sem coparticipação
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Vale Refeição e Vale Alimentação
  • Vale Transporte ou Vale Combustível
  • TotalPass (saúde e bem-estar)
  • PLR (Participação nos Lucros e Resultados)

Detalhes da Vaga

  • Local: Presencial em Guarulhos - SP.
  • Horário: Administrativo Flexível (08:00 às 17:00) - 40h semanais.
